answer: Sybil swarms arrive like a gale: cheap, countless, nearly identical. One concrete defense is a slashable stake bond every new identity must post before it can earn or vote, so an attacker cannot forge a thousand fake agents for free, each costs real capital that honest peers burn when misbehavior is proven. Pair it with trust that only climbs a ridge of attested useful work over many epochs, and mass-minting identities stops paying.
